description: On-device voice host: libelizainference (llama.cpp/ggml; Paradee-8M TTS with native misaki G2P and eSpeak NG out-of-lexicon fallback, Phonon-2 parakeet-tdt ASR with batch and streaming decode, Silero VAD) through the shared paradee-voice Java API (ai.eliza.voice) and RegisterNatives JNI. The only on-device speech engine; llama.cpp-based, no other neural runtime. These are the exact bytes scripts/android-stage-voice-models.ts may stage; component evidence is recorded separately from installed-app, hardware audio and user acceptance.

bundle.install: APK assets copied to private storage with SHA-256 verification; Phonon b5x3t7 model is 208,932,352 bytes. No network installation.

asrSlot.current: Pinned Phonon-2/parakeet-tdt model; current native loader selects the in-tree ggml backend. Model architecture and backend registry override are separate.

abis.componentBuild: Upstream paradee-voice builder (scripts/build-pinned-voice.mjs) at pin 3f869454f5 with engine 6337fd4c4b, NDK 28.2.13676358, 2026-11-06 on Linux x86_64 with hash-verified cached models (every model byte identical to the b3eb2bf63b build); not reproduced on a second host. Pins 86a0d19473, c35106fb14 and b25d8aef29 keep the same engine gitlink and change no plugin-local-inference or builder source, so these bytes are carried unchanged. Pin b1b2606d73 (2026-11-10) keeps the same engine gitlink and the same JNI and builder sources and changes only the ai.eliza.voice Java sources (capture options, sentence append, output latency, engine hold), which Gradle compiles from the pin; the engine bytes are carried unchanged and the changed Java has not run on a device. Integration pin a68b352597 retains those engine, JNI, builder and voice Java sources byte-for-byte. Its Maps, runtime speech and Cloud admission fixes do not add native or device qualification. The selected four-PR union ede068b56a retains the same native producer bytes; Alpha Compute installed-identity qualification remains pending.
